data.gender_notes: Bakhtawara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bakhtawara is a Persian name derived from the Persian words 'Bakht' meaning 'blessing' and 'Wara' meaning 'lady'. This name signifies the one who brings blessings and prosperity to those around her. The name Bakhtawara carries the meaning “Lady of Blessings” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bakhtawara usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of blessings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
